content:
maya: Auditor asked for a single bundle that proves the chain from RBAC change PR -> approval -> deploy -> KMS key usage (create/rotate/delete). Can we assemble that quickly?
kevin: We have PRs and approvals. The tricky part is matching KMS events to the service account that triggered them — need CloudTrail exports.
nashwin: Right. CloudTrail has the events, and CloudWatch/ELB logs show deploy timelines. We can cross-ref by requestId or timestamp window.
ellie: Also include key policy snapshots and IAM role bindings at the time of the change to show separation of duties.
maya: Auditor wants mapping like: control ID -> evidence list (PR link, log snippet, artifact path). Prefer a CSV/markdown.
kevin: I'll export CloudTrail filtered for kms:CreateKey, kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, kms:EnableKeyRotation for the dates in question. Use this snippet: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateKey --start-time 2024-10-01 --end-time 2024-11-01 --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > kms_create_events.json
```
ashwin: Add a short script to extract userIdentity.arn and eventTime, then map to PR merge timestamps. That mapping is the core of the chainproof.
samir: For CVE triage evidence, auditor also wants ticket numbers + patch PR + verification logs. We should include a sample triage record per vuln.
maya: Do we have a pre-made template for vuln -> ticket -> mitigation -> verify?
samir: Yes, security repo has "vuln-triage-template.md". I'll snapshot it and include a filled example for the recent package vuln.
ellie: Reminder: mask any internal IPs and redact token IDs before packaging. The compliance checklist lists redaction steps.
kevin: I'll prepare a README that lists files and control mappings. Example mapping row: "CTRL-A.6 -> pr/9384.md, kms_create_events.json#event[12], iam_policy_snapshot/2024-10-15.json"
maya: Timeline: auditor wants deliverable by tomorrow EOD. @kevin @ashwin can you own the bundle and the mapping doc?
kevin: I can own the logs/export and README.
ashwin: I'll produce the policy snapshots, PR links, and deploy logs by 3pm.
compliance-bot: evidence-collector: started export job 2159999999-artifact-bundle
kevin: After export I'll run a quick sanity script to verify each PR in the mapping has a matching event (within 5 minute tolerance).
maya: Perfect. Also include a short chain-of-custody note: who exported, who transferred, S3 path and retention.
compliance-bot: evidence-collector: export in progress (30% complete)
kevin: Packaging excludes sensitive debug dumps per redaction list.
ellie: When you upload, set ACL to private and give auditor a presigned URL; include MD5 checksum in README.
samir: I'll attach the vuln-triage snapshot and the corresponding verification logs to the bundle.
compliance-bot: evidence-collector: export finished and uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/2159999999/artifact-bundle.tar.gz (expires in 72h)
maya: Uploaded? I'll review and generate the final control mapping spreadsheet before we hand off. :thumbsup:
kevin: Uploaded the logs and README. README includes mapping.csv and a short note about redactions.
ashwin: Policy snapshots and PR list uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/2159999999/policies_and_prs/
maya: Thanks everyone — I'll validate and send to auditor once I confirm redactions. Ping here if anything changes.
